raw_output.question: According to Hobbes, what happens when two people want the same thing that only one can have?

key_points.statement: Hobbes claims that equal abilities lead people to have equal hopes of achieving their goals.
key_points.quote: From this equality of ability, ariseth equality of hope in the attaining of our Ends.
key_points.speaker: author_sincere

key_points.statement: Hobbes asserts that when two people desire the same exclusive thing, they become enemies and may try to destroy or subdue each other.
key_points.quote: if any two men desire the same thing, which neverthelesse they cannot both enjoy, they become enemies; and in the way to their End...endeavour to destroy, or subdue one an other.
key_points.speaker: author_sincere
